resources.string: The LG-XMB waves, adapted for your phone.
Choose your screens in the preview. Settings apply immediately if the wallpaper is already active.
The system wallpaper picker is unavailable.
Choose XMB Waves in Android’s screen saver settings. These levels only apply while the screen saver runs; 100% keeps the normal brightness.
This device does not provide screen saver settings.
Keep this at 100% for bright sparkles over a dim background.
Use seasonal colours, follow your Android palette, or keep a fixed month.
Automatic follows your local clock. Day and Night keep that lighting throughout the day.
Distance from the top of the screen. 50% centres the waves.
Swipe between home screens to reveal more of the waves. Your launcher must support wallpaper scrolling.
The first home screen shows the left side of the waves. Lower values give a gentler shift; 100% travels across the full scene. At 0%, that left view stays still.
Briefly adds movement when you change home screens. At 0%, the panorama still scrolls without the extra movement.
The XMB particle response when you change home screens.
Tilt or gently move your phone to stir the waves and sparkles. Only active while the wallpaper is visible.
60 fps gives smoother motion. 30 fps reduces rendering work.
100% renders at the wallpaper surface size. Lower values draw fewer pixels and soften fine details.
128 × 128 gives finer wave curves. 64 × 64 uses fewer triangles.
The maximum number of sparkles. Fewer sparkles reduce drawing work. Off also stops their simulation.
Smooths the wave edges with a small amount of extra rendering work.
Animation pauses while the wallpaper is hidden.
